item.title: States Weekly: February 25, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers February 25, 2026.

item.title: The Russia-Ukraine War and Global Food Security: Impacts Four Years Later
item.description: Russia’s war in Ukraine caused immediate and widespread disruptions to Ukraine’s agriculture sector and global food markets. Today, new patterns are emerging, affecting Ukraine’s agricultural recovery and Russia’s ability to use its food exports for political benefit.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine War in 10 Charts
item.description: Four years after Russia’s full-scale invasion, the war in Ukraine has reshaped European security, global markets, and the balance of power. These 10 charts break down the battlefield, economic strain, military aid shifts, reconstruction costs, and what comes next.

item.title: The Purges Within China’s Military Are Even Deeper Than You Think
item.description: This CSIS China Power report is based on a groundbreaking dataset of Chinese military purges since 2022. The report sheds light on the unprecedented scope and reach of these purges and their implications for the PLA’s present and future.

item.title: Four Years of the War in Ukraine
item.description: CSIS experts discuss the last four years of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Revitalizing U.S.-Pacific Ties Through Kava Diplomacy
item.description: With U.S. aid declining in the Pacific Islands, kava trade plays a growing role in rebuilding regional economic ties.

item.title: All Together Now: China’s Militia in 2025
item.description: China’s militia presence hits a record high.

item.title: The Supreme Court’s IEEPA Tariff Ruling and What Comes Next
item.description: This week, Bill Reinsch discusses the implications of the Supreme Court ruling that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) does not permit tariffs.
